title: [GraalVM for JDK 24+] org.jboss.threads.JDKSpecific$ThreadAccess needs --add-opens java.base/java.lang=ALL-UNNAMED
body:
### Describe the bug

All GraalVM native integration tests are failing due to this issue. With JDK 24+ or better we see failures in native integration tests that look like this:

```

```

See for example here:
GraalVM for JDK 25: https://github.com/graalvm/mandrel/actions/runs/14675818522/job/41192690018#step:12:3133
Mandrel for JDK 24: https://github.com/graalvm/mandrel/actions/runs/14686316045/job/41216032504#step:12:3200

### Expected behavior

Native IT tests with GraalVM for JDK 24+ pass.

### Actual behavior

All native IT tests fail.

### How to Reproduce?

Reproducer:

Run any native integration test with a GraalVM for JDK 24+. For example a build from here: 
https://github.com/graalvm/mandrel/releases/tag/mandrel-24.2.1.0-Final

### Output of `uname -a` or `ver`

Linux x86_64

### Mandrel or GraalVM version (if different from Java)

GraalVM/Mandrel for JDK 24 (or better).

### Quarkus version or git rev

latest main
